name: Elemental Resonance: Impetuous Winds
description:
The next time you perform "Switch Character": This action will be considered a Fast Action instead of a Combat Action. It will also cost 1 fewer Elemental Die.
The next Swirl Reaction you trigger deals +1 DMG to all opposing characters except the target.
(You must have at least 2 Anemo characters in your deck to add this card to your deck.)
